name: qfd_sp_res_train_par_2_c1-c1-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen compute die v1.4 master qfd_sp_res_train_par_2 (band 2 parallel result-train serializer, ~119k FF): flat leaf at the exact die frame 777.576 x 518.376, 25 related same-phase CTS roots (ck controller + 24 ck_bank storage roots of ~4.9k FF each; die.v ties all 25 entries to one die clock net), recipe-3 pin registers on every input/output (ck domain; rq/train command +1 edge together, rb/fault +1: the compiler calendar absorbs them), rst_n captured by one station flop (cold init only). Pins: die faces/order, spread along the face to <= 8 pins/um.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_sp_res_train_par_2 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_res_train_par.sv rtl/qwen_split/qfd_sp_res_train_par.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: rtp_exact_3band_composition
bench.pass_regex: RTP_BENCH PASS trains=60 rows=4948 rb_words=5591 errors=0

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_res_train_par_2_c1/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_sp_res_train_par_2_c1/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes
